_comment: Advisories the build is allowed to ship with, and why. Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs.
A waiver is a claim that the vulnerable code path cannot be reached from this project.
It is not a way to silence an advisory that is merely inconvenient to fix.
Every entry expires; an expired waiver fails the build so the claim gets re-checked.

multer.reason: @nestjs/platform-express pins multer 2.2.0 exactly, so npm keeps a nested copy that no override reaches. All four advisories need a multipart request: the project has no upload endpoint, no FileInterceptor and no route that accepts multipart/form-data, so the parser is loaded but never fed. Drops off when platform-express bumps its pin.
